name: Home window
description: SuiteWindow over a HomeModel: sidebar (Home, Assets, the five apps), Open… and search in the toolbar, the recents grid with app filter chips, the "Preview data" pill on the fakes, empty, no-match and missing-file states in place, the running apps strip; the New row (one tile per app, presets as chips or a menu by HomeLayout.tileShowsChips, disabled reasons, a progress hook) and the inspector (Open, Open In disabled until recents-open-in, Show in Finder, Locate…, Remove from Recents); HomeLayoutAnchors publishes frames for the layout test. Publishes the model as the homeModel focused value.
